value.rationale: The authors define a new family of generally high-codimension Grassmannian ratio varieties, compute its dimension and note that one component of each generic fiber is a torus orbit. Their setup leaves a natural degree/identifiability gap. Proving all-n rationality and that the torus accounts for the *entire* generic fiber resolves the geometry of parameter recovery and gives a concrete function-field description; this is a structural birational invariant, not simply a reparametrized numerical example.
